title: Define MIME parsed node schema — single-part and multipart
description: Specify Rust types for the mime_cid subtree. Single-part: {content_type: String, transfer_encoding: String, decoded_cid: Cid}. Multipart: {content_type: String, parts: Vec<MimePart>} where MimePart has {content_type, decoded_cid}. v1 scope: text parts only; binary parts get a decoded_cid pointing to raw bytes with a binary flag set and no further parsing.
notes: Size: S. Depends on Issue A (Define article root node DAG-CBOR schema).
